title: OpenUI configuration
description: Configuration for the OpenUI CLI and component registry (openui.json). Paths are resolved relative to the consuming project's root.

$schema.description: URL of this schema for editor validation and completion.

framework.description: Target framework. `auto` (default) detects the framework from the project's dependencies and config files. Explicit values skip detection.

typescript.description: Install TypeScript component variants when available (for example `button.tsx` instead of `button.jsx`).

css.description: Path, relative to the project root, to the global Tailwind CSS entry file. OpenUI theme tokens are written relative to this file.

prefix.description: Tailwind class prefix configured in the consuming project, if any.

aliases.description: Import aliases used by generated import statements and install destinations.

components.description: Import alias for the components directory.

ui.description: Import alias for UI primitives. Installed components target this directory.

url.description: Registry root: an http(s) URL serving `index.json` and `r/*.json`, or a filesystem path (absolute, or relative to the project root).
